title: Megurine Luka — Lay Your Feelings Bare〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay, see you all later!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
See you!
Come back to talk whenever you like!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I never would have thought An was worried about something like this.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, right.
This was your first time hearing about it.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Which means you two knew for quite some time. Honestly, why'd you keep this a secret from me...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I'm sorry...
But it seemed like a sensitive topic.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I was joking.
If you put yourself in An's shoes, it's natural to have kept it secret. I can understand why she wouldn't want to discuss this lightly.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: If anything, I feel really guilty for messing up like I did...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I was just eavesdropping to be playful like usual, but that was definitely a mistake...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But now that I know, I'll do my best to keep it a secret.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm going to zip my lips and not tell a soul about An's feelings!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I don't think you have to be that passionate about it...
Oh! Hiya, Luka, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: *Scream*

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Geez, you scared me!
Don't scream like that!
se_walk_men_001_1
se_walk_men_001_2

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Luka?
bgm_area00003

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
S-Sorry!
You startled me, showing up out of the blue like that! Haha...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay, if that's all...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Y-Yikes, I thought my heart was going to stop! I still haven't had a chance to get into secret-keeping mode...!)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Anyway, what were you two doing just now?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Huh? U-Uhh... We were just...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: An, Toya and Akito were just here. Toya wanted to ask Luka something about his song.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wait, really?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I see...
So, Luka, did things seem to be going well for him?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Uhh, yes! Very well!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Really...?
Then, that's good to hear...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You're acting kinda funny today, Luka...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Wh-What are you talking about?!
I'm acting the way I usually do!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hmm... I dunno...
Something seems off here...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (N-Not good! I need to change the subject fast! Let me think. Uhh...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: W-Wait, that reminds me!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: KAITO, are you going over to MEIKO's place again today to have some more of that fizzy fruit gelato?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh? What are you...?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Len & Rin
rows.Line: Fizzy fruit gelato...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes! MEIKO made some specially for us the other day, and—

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: N-No, Luka, wait...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I thought we promised to have one serving and keep it a secret!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Huh? O-Oh no! I forgot...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What's this gelato you guys are talking about?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And it's no fair that you were keeping it a secret from us! Tell us more about it!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh? I-It's...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, so... She made it with mint from An's place, some frozen fruit and soda. And it tasted divine...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But we forgot to write down the recipe, and there's only a little bit left.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Luka, wait! Why are you telling them everything?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Huh?!
B-But they just told us to tell them more...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah, KAITO, quit holding out on us!
I wanna try some now!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Me too! Me too!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
N-No, like Luka said!
There's only a little bit left!

rows.Speaker: Len & Rin
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: L-Let's all just take a second to settle down...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Miku, help! What do we do?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
(An...
I fear that your secret's going to get out if you don't figure out a solution to your problem soon.)
